title: Inbox Metric1 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inbox:metric1 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for inbox metric1 (1) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for inbox metric1 (1) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It catches the smoothed week-long trend in your value from inbox metric1 (1).
